sources.title: GitHub - r33drichards/laya-vision: Image inputs for Laya: calibrated ...
sources.snippet: Laya Vision is an independent fork of Laya that replaces its ModernBERT text encoder with a small vision-language model. Laya's predict (state, questions) API, output schema, RLCD training objective and temperature calibration are unchanged. It is an experimental research project, not affiliated with Convai Innovations, the authors of Laya.
